versions.changelog:
- Initial release of omem-memory: trustworthy, self-hosted memory for agent-based belief management.
- Tracks both sides of conflicting facts, avoiding silent overwrites and enabling contradiction detection.
- Provides provenance and an evidence chain for all beliefs, supporting audit trails and explainable reasoning.
- All data is stored on the user’s self-hosted OMEM server; no external connections or data sharing.
- Includes clear setup instructions and command-line tools for remembering, recalling, auditing, and checking beliefs.
